title: 第2325章 被人吼了一嗓子 就这样了第2324章 小娘皮又馋本帝的身子了
content_zh:
金魔帝被风家家主夫妇寄予厚望，和风家小公主风美玲努力造娃的时候，魔稽山一群老魔帝却把注意力集中到金魔帝的魔帝宫。
魔帝宫这群老古董对隐世家族之首郑家小少主的分身，也就是郑风替身郑鹏的分身很有兴趣。
他们并不清楚郑鹏并非真正的郑家小少主，郑鹏作为郑风替身是郑家的高度机密，知晓者不超一手之数。何况郑鹏为了扮演郑家小少主郑风，修行了风雷剑诀和风雷拳，这是郑家的镇族功法。只有嫡系一脉嫡子嫡孙才能修行。郑鹏在公众视线里施展过风雷剑诀和风雷拳，所以无论人族隐世家族圈还是魔族探子，对郑鹏的身份毫无质疑。
“虽然只是郑家小少主的一道分身，但你们家金小子把他弄到本族也并非易事。以郑渊泓护犊子的性格，和强大的实力，知晓真相后，还不得找他的麻烦，真是胆肥了！”
一鹤发童颜的紫袍老魔放下手里的茶盏，瞥了一眼和他对座的金衣老者，打趣地笑道。
“年轻人嘛！正常！没有考虑那么多，哪有你这样老谋深算浑身上下有八百个心眼子。你们家那位宝贝孙子不是也到人族地界去鬼混了？不知有没有什么新的消息发送回来？”
金衣老者正是金魔帝的长辈，直接言语犀利地怼了回去。
“呵呵，老王家的孙子有出息了？也跑到人族地界去混个脸熟了？”
一会一老头，笑得一脸褶子，乐颠颠打着哈哈缓步走来。
“你们几个老家伙，聊天喝茶怎么不叫一声，老哥也好准备一下！”
有一位身着藏青色袍子的老者有些埋怨，走到茶案前丢出一个酒葫芦。
“诶，拿开拿开，我们品茶，你上一葫芦酒算怎么回事？”
“何需拘泥于形式，茶酒不都是用来喝的嘛！何必在意那么多？李老头，你说是不是这个理？”
踏踏踏
踏踏踏
马蹄声响起，由远及近，很快一道衣着褴褛的身影端坐马背上，飞驰而来。
姓王的老头子坐不住了，茶杯一甩，身形一闪，直奔来人而去。
袖袍一卷，将来人从马背上包裹下来，朗声询问。
“宝贝孙儿，谁把你打成这样？”
一群老家伙纷纷起身，将王老头爷孙围了起来，关切之意溢于言表。

都是魔稽山上的老怪物，但有孙儿的不多，尤其是孙儿还是魔帝的更少。金老头侄孙，王老头孙儿都是魔帝，为此他们在一群老魔帝心中可是有些显摆的。
“爷爷，和我对战的人族少年年龄并不大，开始易容了，看起来还是一位老者，可后来三位分身现身，都是青葱少年。而他神色一变，和三位分身毫无二致，到那时孙儿才知晓，至始至终对方本尊就没出手，当机立断撤离！”
“难道你被一位人族少年的分身搞出了一身伤？”
王老头闻话不由得老脸一红，若真是这样，脸丢大了！
“那倒不是，孙儿成功撤离，撤离时速度够快，少年并未追来。”
王老头松了口气，只要不是伤在人族少年手上，还不至于那么丢脸。
“你是说被人族的老家伙欺负了？”
“人族那些老家伙一个比一个没品，居然敢对我们魔族年轻一辈出手，也不自持身份！”
一群老魔帝怒不可遏，今日是王家老头孙儿被欺负，他日他们的后人去人族也会如此。
“打狗还得看主人呢，人族那些老家伙这样目中无人，没品没德吗？”
李姓老头气愤填膺地说道，说完又觉得说错了什么。当即纠正。
“老朽就是打个比方，不是真的说你孙儿是狗！”
平日里打趣两声无妨，没看王老头因为孙儿受伤正愁没处发泄，此时此刻何必言语激怒他。
content_en:
The Golden Demon Emperor has high hopes from the head of the Feng family and his wife. While Feng Meiling, the little princess of the Feng family, is working hard to have a baby, a group of old Demon Emperors in Moji Mountain focus their attention on the Golden Demon Emperor's Palace.
The group of old antiques in the Demon Emperor's Palace are very interested in the clone of the young master of the Zheng family, the head of the hidden family, that is, the clone of Zheng Feng's stand-in Zheng Peng.
They don't know that Zheng Peng is not the real young master of the Zheng family. Zheng Peng's role as Zheng Feng's substitute is a highly confidential secret of the Zheng family, and no one knows more than one person. What's more, in order to play the role of Zheng Feng, the young master of the Zheng family, Zheng Peng practiced the Wind and Thunder Sword Art and the Wind and Thunder Fist, which are the Zheng family's clan-suppressing skills. Only direct descendants and direct descendants of the same lineage can practice cultivation. Zheng Peng has performed the Wind and Thunder Sword Art and the Wind and Thunder Fist in the public eye, so no matter the human hidden family circle or the demon spies, there is no doubt about Zheng Peng's identity.
"Although he is just a clone of the young master of the Zheng family, it is not easy for your golden boy to get him into the family. With Zheng Yuanhong's protective character and strong strength, after knowing the truth, you still have to find trouble with him. It is really cowardly!"
The purple-robed old devil with a childish face put down the tea cup in his hand, glanced at the golden-robed old man sitting opposite him, and said with a joking smile.
"Young man! It's normal! You don't think so much. How can you be so sophisticated and have eight hundred tricks in your body? Didn't your precious grandson also go to the human realm to fool around? I wonder if there is any new news sent back?"
The old man in golden clothes was the elder of the Golden Demon Emperor, and he retorted directly and sharply.
"Haha, the grandson of the old Wang family is promising? Has he also gone to the human race to make a name for himself?"
After a while, an old man came slowly with a smile on his face and a cheerful laugh.
"You old guys, why don't you shout while chatting and drinking tea? Brother, I'd better get ready!"
An old man in a navy blue robe complained a little, walked up to the tea table and threw a wine gourd.
"Hey, put it away, let's have tea, what's the point of you serving a gourd of wine?"
"Why stick to the formalities? Tea and wine are just for drinking! Why should we care so much? Old man Li, do you think this is true?"
Tap tap tap
Tap tap tap
The sound of horse hooves sounded from far to near, and soon a ragged figure sat on a horse and galloped over.
The old man surnamed Wang couldn't sit still. He swung his tea cup, flashed his figure, and ran straight towards the person who came.
The sleeves and robes were rolled up, and the incoming man was wrapped up from the horse and asked loudly.
"My dear grandson, who beat you like this?"
A group of old guys got up one after another and surrounded Old Man Wang's grandfather and grandson, their concern was palpable.
They are all old monsters from Moji Mountain, but not many of them have grandchildren, especially those whose grandchildren are Demon Emperors. Old Man Jin's grandnephew and Old Man Wang's grandson are both Demon Emperors, so they are a bit showy in the hearts of a group of old Demon Emperors.
"Grandpa, the human boy I was fighting against was not very old. He started to change his appearance. He still looked like an old man. But then three clones appeared, all young men. And his expression changed, and he was exactly the same as the three clones. Only then did my grandson know that the opponent had not taken any action from the beginning to the end, and evacuated immediately!"
"Did you get injured by the clone of a human boy?"
Old man Wang couldn't help but blush when he heard what he said. If this was really the case, he would be so embarrassed!
"That's not true. My grandson successfully evacuated. He evacuated quickly enough that the boy didn't chase him."
Old Man Wang breathed a sigh of relief. As long as he wasn't injured in the hands of a human boy, it wouldn't be so embarrassing.
"You mean you were bullied by an old guy from the human race?"
"Those old fellows from the human race are more and more incompetent. They actually dare to take action against the younger generation of our demon race, and they don't maintain their identity!"
A group of old demon emperors were furious. Today, the grandson of the old man of the Wang family was bullied, and their descendants will do the same to the human race in the future.
"When you beat a dog, it depends on the owner. Those old guys from the human race are so arrogant and have no moral character.? "
The old man surnamed Li said angrily, and after finishing speaking, he felt that he had said something wrong. Correct immediately.
"I'm just making an analogy, I'm not really saying your grandson is a dog! "
It's okay to make a few jokes on weekdays, but Old Man Wang has nowhere to vent his worries because his grandson is injured, so why bother irritating him with words at this moment.
